target.title: refactor(ui): trim private API type exports
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Control UI API modules expose eight support types and duplicate usage aliases that have no production consumer. Keeping them exported widens an unsupported internal surface and requires permanent dead-code baseline entries.

## Why This Change Was Made

This change makes four implementation-only types private, removes four unused usage-type re-exports, and lets the reconnect test infer its fixture shape from the retained behavior contract. The underlying runtime types and behavior remain unchanged.

## User Impact

No user-visible impact. This narrows internal Control UI module contracts and removes eight dead-code baseline entries.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxcbqtnd02jn0bb9412pp2bx`: 99 focused assertions passed across Gateway and Control UI shards.
- `pnpm check:changed -- scripts/deadcode-exports.baseline.mjs src/gateway/reconnect-gating.test.ts ui/src/api/gateway.ts ui/src/api/types.ts`: passed core-test, UI, tooling, typecheck, formatting, and lint lanes.
- Full open-PR semantic overlap audit found no PR changing these eight symbols; overlapping files modify separate fields or shared baseline regions.
- Fresh dirty-tree `gpt-5.6-sol` medium autoreview: clean, confidence `0.93`.
- Fresh exact-commit `gpt-5.6-sol` medium autoreview: clean, confidence `0.97`.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
- Standalone `pnpm deadcode:exports` reports only the separately audited current-main MCP-app drift and stale `visitSessionMessagesAsync` baseline row; none is introduced or touched here.
- Changelog: not required for this internal type/export cleanup.
